name: ShinyText-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The gradient runs from dim grey to bright white across the full headline, with the smaller line clear beneath.

tagline: A bright sheen sweeps across dim text in an endless loop.
summary: Two lines of grey text sit on black while a metallic white highlight travels through the letters. The band moves from one side to the other and repeats without pausing.
appearance: Two lines of sans-serif copy on a plain black stage: a large grey sentence and a much smaller second line below it. The letters brighten to near-white inside a soft diagonal band that crosses them.
behaviour: A diagonal white band drifts steadily across the text, lighting the letters it passes, then restarts once it leaves the far side. The sweep never settles.
demo_content: Two lines reading 'Shine bright like a component.' and 'Light moves. Text stays.'
search_phrases: text with a light sweeping over it
animated gradient text for a hero
chrome like sheen on white text
use_when: A short headline should catch the eye gently without a video or images.
avoid_when: It needs a dark backdrop to read well and the loop never fully rests.
customise: Text, speed, base and shine colours, gradient angle, yoyo reversal, hover pause, direction and a start delay are props.
weight_why: One text span whose background position is updated each frame; no extra nodes.

a11y.note: The sheen loops forever with no prefers-reduced-motion check, which can distract light-sensitive readers.

issues: Much of the headline sits in dim grey, uncomfortable to read until the shine reaches it.
polish_why: Clean type and an even sweep, but the effect is a familiar trick with little extra detail.
title: ShinyText
